text.en: Most pet owners share that the groomers handle their dogs with patience and affection, helping nervous animals feel settled and relaxed during their appointments. One client noted that an anxious pup who arrived trembling left cheerful and calm. However, an owner reported their pet was overstimulated following an extended stay in the salon environment.

Clients praise Jennifer and her colleagues for their friendly demeanour, helpful guidance, and dedication to customer care. Reviewers note that the team speaks in calm, comforting tones to pets throughout bathing and clipping. Even critical feedback acknowledges that staff members genuinely attempt to show kindness and care while working with the animals.

Pet parents express satisfaction with the styling, hygiene baths, and nail trimming delivered by the team. Reviews highlight that dogs emerge looking tidy, cleanly brushed, and well cared for. Clients appreciate the groomers' practical advice regarding matting and coat maintenance, noting that the styling results leave their pets looking and feeling great.

q.en: How are appointments arranged at Dee's Grooming?

a.en: Appointments are typically scheduled over the phone with the salon team.

q.en: Does the salon handle dogs with grooming anxiety?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that staff speak gently to soothe anxious pets, though wait times can occasionally vary.

q.en: Are nail trims provided for visiting pets?

a.en: Yes, the salon performs nail trims alongside full baths and coat styling sessions.

q.en: What should owners expect regarding wait times?

a.en: While many visits proceed smoothly, one client noted delays when preceding appointments ran longer than scheduled.
